## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A fixture PR of under 50 changed lines touching guardrails.py or a policy...

The system SHALL ensure that a fixture PR of under 50 changed lines touching guardrails.py or a policy file is routed to multi-vendor review; a docs-only PR of over 300 lines is not.

#### Scenario: A fixture PR of under 50 changed lines touching guardrails.py or a policy...

WHEN `judge-multi-vendor-review-eligibility-for-pull-requests` is implemented
THEN A fixture PR of under 50 changed lines touching guardrails.py or a policy file is routed to multi-vendor review; a docs-only PR of over 300 lines is not.

### Requirement: The dependabot/renovate/Jules-subtype origin skip list still short-circuits...

The system SHALL ensure that the dependabot/renovate/Jules-subtype origin skip list still short-circuits before any decision call, asserted by a call-count test.

#### Scenario: The dependabot/renovate/Jules-subtype origin skip list still short-circuits...

WHEN `judge-multi-vendor-review-eligibility-for-pull-requests` is implemented
THEN The dependabot/renovate/Jules-subtype origin skip list still short-circuits before any decision call, asserted by a call-count test.

### Requirement: SMALL_PR_MAX_CHANGED_LINES and SMALL_PR_MAX_FILES move to config and remain...

The system SHALL ensure that sMALL_PR_MAX_CHANGED_LINES and SMALL_PR_MAX_FILES move to config and remain the fallback when the helper returns None.

#### Scenario: SMALL_PR_MAX_CHANGED_LINES and SMALL_PR_MAX_FILES move to config and remain...

WHEN `judge-multi-vendor-review-eligibility-for-pull-requests` is implemented
THEN SMALL_PR_MAX_CHANGED_LINES and SMALL_PR_MAX_FILES move to config and remain the fallback when the helper returns None.

### Requirement: The eligibility record in the merge report carries evidence_class...

The system SHALL ensure that the eligibility record in the merge report carries evidence_class "judgment", the risk score and its probability.

#### Scenario: The eligibility record in the merge report carries evidence_class...

WHEN `judge-multi-vendor-review-eligibility-for-pull-requests` is implemented
THEN The eligibility record in the merge report carries evidence_class "judgment", the risk score and its probability.
